screenshots.alt: Dusk on a Forest map. The lamps are lit and the troop is inside the wall.
The camp at 1 PM, in full daylight.
The same camp at 11 PM, lit by lamps and the campfire.
A night raid breaking through one quarter of the camp wall.
The Honey Bandit, an alpha bear, at the edge of the camp with its attack marked on the ground.
Three scouts at the mouth of a bear den, its card reading the odds of a raid.
A camp in the Jungle, with dense trees around the wall.
A Tundra night. A scout away from the fire turns blue from the cold.
The morning report, one row per scout for the whole day and night.
